list_interviews.title: List interviews
list_interviews.description: List completed candidate interviews: for each, the job and interview name, the candidate's name, email and phone, links to the recorded video, thumbnail and share page, the date and duration, and the time offset of each question in the recording.

list_interview_responses.title: List interview responses
list_interview_responses.description: List candidates' interview responses, the connector's own verification call. Use list_interviews for the documented interview records with video links.

register_webhook.title: Register a webhook
register_webhook.description: Register a webhook URL that Async Interview calls whenever a new interview response is received. This is the hook the Zapier integration uses; registering a new URL replaces the previous one.

delete_webhook.title: Delete the webhook
delete_webhook.description: Remove the registered webhook URL so Async Interview stops sending new-response notifications.
